# Country scope. Valid landed non-rebel carrier for oe_global_kernel.
oe_gk_is_valid_carrier = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	num_locations > 0
}

# Any scope. True when BYZ's 1337 mainline scheduler (oe_clock_mainline) will NOT run this month.
oe_gk_mainline_absent = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
		c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = yes }
		NOT = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
	}
}

# Any scope. Quarter boundary months (1 / 4 / 7 / 10).
oe_gk_is_quarter_month = {
	OR = {
		current_month = 1
		current_month = 4
		current_month = 7
		current_month = 10
	}
}

oe_gk_preset_is_standard = {

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). At least one imperial expansion charter or Prefecture is unlocked.
oe_v150_has_any_expansion_zone_unlocked = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_theme_pref_1_unlocked
		has_variable = oe_theme_pref_2_unlocked
		has_variable = oe_theme_pref_3_unlocked
		has_variable = oe_theme_pref_4_unlocked
		AND = {
			has_variable = oe_ir_italian_theme_done
			oe_italian_theme_creation_unlocked = yes
		}
		has_variable = oe_create_eastern_themes_done
		has_variable = oe_create_austrian_themes_done
		has_variable = oe_create_swiss_themes_done
	}
}

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Any of the 4 Praetorian Prefectures currently has an eligible creatable region (R02-R79).
# v26.0 WP11: replaces the retired ghost oe_theme_found_expansion_all_action checks.
oe_v150_any_expansion_theme_creatable = {
	oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes
	OR = {
		oe_theme_pref_any_creatable_1 = yes
		oe_theme_pref_any_creatable_2 = yes
		oe_theme_pref_any_creatable_3 = yes
		oe_theme_pref_any_creatable_4 = yes
	}
}

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). True when an Eastern Exarchate (E01-E10) is ready OR a consolidatable theme pair exists.
oe_v150_any_consolidatable_theme_pair = {
	oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes
	OR = {
		oe_theme_any_exarchate_ready = yes
		AND = {
			any_subject = {
				count >= 2
				oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
			}
			any_subject = {
				oe_t2_can_be_consolidated_recipient = yes
				oe_theme_jurisdiction_size <= 25
			}
			any_subject = {
				oe_theme_convertible_trigger = yes
				oe_t2_receiver_under_region_cap = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
				OR = {
					var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 2
					var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 3
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
